_comment: Secondary departments only. The hospital-speciality → department mapping now lives in
incoming/Dept_Map.tsv, which is the authoritative sheet.
A secondary department says: this surgery is commonly performed by another team, so a hospital
listing that other department should also match. Resolution is transitive and cycle-safe.
Without these, 'Piles' returns nothing — its department is Proctology and no active hospital
lists Proctology, even though Proctology exists in the speciality master.

addedByAnalysis.Gastrointestinal: GI surgery is done by general surgeons at most panel hospitals
addedByAnalysis.Transplant Surgery: no hospital lists it; kidney/liver transplant may also warrant Urology / Nephrology
addedByAnalysis.Neurology: only 'Pediatric Neurology' exists hospital-side, so adult neurology resolves to nothing otherwise

_provenance._note: Confirm the three under addedByAnalysis — they are clinical judgements.
